row: A view into sharing my life with my 2 boys Brodie a 2 year old Australian Cattle Dog and Uthando (Zulu name that means Love a play on part of his racing name Endearing) a 4 year off the Track Thoroughbred Rescue whose racing name was Endearing Suances. I strive to share day to day adventures and activities we do together.
